subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps after discovery call (CFO / Procurement intro)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@sagefin.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks for the demo — quick recap & next steps

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really great to learn about Sage Financial's use cases for automated report generation and the month-end reconciliation workflow. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key pain: 3–4 hour manual reconciliation work per team, unpredictable latency on current models, and escalating token costs on peak months.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: accuracy on financial language, latency under 500ms 95th percentile for interactive queries, and vendor security posture (SOC 2 + data residency).
- Stakeholders you flagged: you (product champion), CFO (economic buyer), Procurement (procurement evaluations), and InfoSec/SecOps for security/compliance review.

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you introduce the CFO and procurement contact so we can align on economics and contracting cadence?
2) I’ll share a short ROI one-pager and a suggested meeting agenda for a 30-min CFO + Procurement sync.
3) We’ll also prep the SOC2 checklist and a short technical pre-read for security.

I attached a one-page ROI summary that shows a conservative 25% reduction in human review hours and estimated payback in 3–5 months for a 3-team pilot.

If you’re open, suggested times for the CFO/procurement intro: Tue 3/23 10:00–10:30 or Wed 3/24 14:00–14:30 PT.

Thanks — excited to keep momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood-ROI-one-pager.pdf
From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@sagefin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@sagefin.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — quick recap & next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the ROI one-pager (nice summary). A few notes from my side: 

- I can be the internal champion and will own the product/ops alignment.
- CFO is Anil Desai (anil.desai@sagefin.com) — he wants to see concrete unit economics and a pilot scope before any commit.
- Procurement lead is Liza Chen (procurement@sagefin.com) — their standard procurement timeline is ~4–6 weeks for a pilot SOW depending on security deliverables.
- InfoSec will want SOC2 evidence and a data-flow diagram showing no PII leaves our VPC. I’ve cc'd procurement so they have visibility.

I’ll introduce you to Anil and Liza in a separate thread tomorrow but we can tentatively hold Wed 3/24 14:00 PT for a 30-min alignment.

Quick ask for our meeting: can you include a short slide with pricing bands for a 3-month pilot and the expected cost savings (monthly) reflected alongside implementation effort? That will help Anil. Also include the security checklist if you have it.

Thanks,
Emily
Director of Product Management | Sage Financial
emily.stone@sagefin.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@sagefin.com>, Anil Desai <anil.desai@sagefin.com>, procurement@sagefin.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-19T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed agenda & champion talking points for Wed 3/24 (30m)

Hi Emily / Anil / Liza — thanks for the fast turnaround. Per Emily’s note, here’s a short agenda for Wed 3/24 14:00 PT and a couple of one-line talk tracks Emily can use to brief Anil.

Proposed 30-min agenda:
- 0–5m: Introductions & pilot objectives (Emily)
- 5–15m: Technical approach & security posture (Dev)
- 15–25m: Economics & pilot SOW overview (Marissa/Vivek)
- 25–30m: Next steps & timeline (All)

Champion talk tracks (short bullets Emily can copy):
- Business outcome: Reduce manual reconciliation time by ~25% across three teams; expect 3–5 month payback on pilot.
- Risk mitigation: Redwood supports private deployments (VPC), SOC2 evidence, daily audit logs, and per-route tracing for sensitive workflows.
- Contract ask: Quick pilot SOW (~3 months), capped spend for pilot, and a playbook for evaluating accuracy/regression.

Pricing bands (high level for the meeting):
- Pilot (3 teams, up to 100k tokens/month): $X/month (pilot discount applied) — detailed pricing in follow-up slide.
- Production (per-token + reserved capacity options) — we’ll present options depending on throughput needs.

I’ve attached a SOC2 checklist and a draft SOW for procurement review (Dev will go through the security items in the meeting).

Look forward to it — Emily, if you can send the calendar invite and include Anil & Liza, we’ll prepare the short slide deck and leave room for clarifying security questions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2-Checklist.xlsx; SOW-draft-v1.docx

Date: 2026-03-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Proposed agenda & champion talking points for Wed 3/24 (30m)

Thanks team — quick internal note:
- Marissa: for the meeting keep the pricing slide at a high level; don’t show per-token line items unless Anil asks. Show pilot total cost and expected ROI, and have the detailed model as backup.
- Emily / Anil: our ask for procurement will be a pilot SOW with standard NDA + limited data processing addendum; if procurement pushes for enterprise terms we’ll escalate.
- Internal owners: Dev will own the security pre-read, Marissa/Vivek will own economics.

Deal ops: noted deal_id RDW-4872 — target close for pilot PO: 2026-04-30 if pilot goes well.

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: SOC2 checklist + technical pre-read for Wed 3/24

Hi Emily / team — attaching the SOC2 checklist and a draft SOW for the pilot. Highlights for InfoSec to review quickly:

- SOC2: We’ve included the audit statement, scope, and our control descriptions; note support for both hosted and private (VPC) deployment models.
- Data flow: In the pilot we can support in-region deployments and customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest. No customer PII leaves your VPC in the private deployment option.
- Integration: simple REST API with SDKs, streaming responses supported, and per-route logging for auditability.

Please review the SOC2-Checklist.xlsx before Wed and flag any hard blockers. I’ll present the technical slide (5–10 min) and be available for deeper follow-ups.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
